channel.title: BestVPNs: Blog
channel.description: VPN and privacy guides for US, UK and European readers: protocols explained, leak tests, VPN vs Tor vs proxy, and practical tips to stay safer online.

item.title: VPN kill switch explained: what it does and whether you need one
item.description: What a VPN kill switch does, why traffic can leak when a VPN drops, how always-on connections help and what to check in your settings before relying on one.

item.title: Black Friday and Cyber Monday VPN deals: how to spot real offers and avoid scams
item.description: Shopping for a VPN or any Black Friday deal? FTC-backed tips to spot fake sites, check renewal prices, pay safely and protect yourself on public Wi-Fi.

item.title: VPN free trials, renewals and cancelling: what to check before you pay
item.description: VPN free trials, auto-renewals and cancelling explained for US and UK users: what to check before paying, refund rights and how to avoid surprise charges.

item.title: How to test your VPN for IP, DNS and WebRTC leaks
item.description: How to test your VPN for leaks in five minutes: check your IP address, DNS requests, WebRTC and IPv6, what each result means and how to fix any leaks you find.

item.title: VPN vs Tor vs proxy: what’s the difference?
item.description: VPN vs Tor vs proxy explained: how each routes your traffic, what they hide, speed and privacy trade-offs, and which to use when.

item.title: WireGuard vs OpenVPN: which VPN protocol should you use?
item.description: WireGuard vs OpenVPN compared: how each protocol works, speed and security, privacy considerations, and which to choose in your VPN app for everyday use.
